name: Carbonyl Chemistry
description: Basic carbonyl chemistry and transformations, Aldol and related reactions, Malonic and acetoacetic esters. Directed aldol and alkylation reactions; stereoselective and asymmetric synthesis; Crams, Felkin Anh and Crams dipolar models; stereoselective aldol reactions; Mukiyama aldol reaction; asymmetric versions using chiral auxillaries. Basic organometallic chemistry: Synthesis and reactions of various organometallic reagents.
